name: Default
shortDescription: Multi-tenant AI agent gateway with a web dashboard for agents, teams, memory, tools and messaging channels, backed by PostgreSQL with pgvector and your own LLM provider keys.

alerts.message: Log in to the dashboard with User ID `system` and the value of the GOCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN environment variable. Anyone holding this token has full access.
An API key for an LLM provider (OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI or another supported one) must be added in the setup wizard before agents can reply.
